import base64, json, pathlib, subprocess
repo = "BestNameYet/Terminals"
root = pathlib.Path(".")
agents = root / "AGENTS.md"
assert agents.is_file(), "Missing governing AGENTS.md"
contract = agents.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
assert "Terminals" in contract and "DISCOVERY-04" in contract, "Invalid contract"
readme = root / "README.md"
if readme.is_file():
    readme.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
target_dir = root / "Tasks" / "TasksCompleted"
assert (root / "Tasks").is_dir(), "Tasks root does not exist"
assert not (root / "Tasks" / "AGENTS.md").exists(), "Read applicable Tasks AGENTS.md first"
assert not (target_dir / "AGENTS.md").exists(), "Read applicable TasksCompleted AGENTS.md first"
def gh(method, path, payload=None):
    args = ["gh", "api", "--method", method, "repos/" + repo + "/" + path]
    if payload is not None: args.extend(["--input", "-"])
    p = subprocess.run(args, input=None if payload is None else json.dumps(payload), text=True, capture_output=True, check=False)
    if p.returncode: raise RuntimeError(p.stderr.strip())
    return json.loads(p.stdout)
file_path = "Tasks/TasksCompleted/.gitkeep"
existing = None
try:
    existing = gh("GET", "contents/" + file_path + "?ref=main")
except RuntimeError as e:
    if "HTTP 404" not in str(e): raise
if existing is None:
    response = gh("PUT", "contents/" + file_path, {
        "message": "Create Tasks/TasksCompleted directory",
        "content": base64.b64encode(b"\n").decode("ascii"),
        "branch": "main"
    })
    commit = response.get("commit", {}).get("sha")
    status = "created"
else:
    commit = None
    status = "already_exists"
verified = gh("GET", "contents/" + file_path + "?ref=main")
assert verified.get("type") == "file" and verified.get("path") == file_path
assert base64.b64decode(verified["content"]) == b"\n", "Unexpected placeholder contents"
directory = gh("GET", "contents/Tasks/TasksCompleted?ref=main")
assert any(x.get("path") == file_path for x in directory), "Directory listing verification failed"
print(json.dumps({"status": "VERIFIED", "result": status, "directory": "Tasks/TasksCompleted", "marker": file_path, "commit": commit, "verified_on": "main"}))
